lede: The friendliest sector in the game with a **Mantis problem**: the only place the **Stealth Cruiser quest** can begin, and not one hostile beacon in it is Engi. What shoots at you is pirates, Rebel patrols, and Mantis raiders picking Engi stations apart.

section_notes.HOSTILE_ENGI: The Engi hold a non-aggression pact with the Rebels, so none of these are Engi ships. This line is filled last, so it is also where the shortfall lands: the sector asks for up to 29 beacons on a map that holds 24, and everything above this has already taken its share. Expect the low end of 5–7 more often than the high end.
section_notes.NEUTRAL_ENGI: The deepest pool in the sector, filled second-to-last, and where both halves of the Crystal route sit: {{ASTEROID_DERELICT_SHIP}} hands out the Damaged Stasis Pod, and {{ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY}} is where the pod becomes a Crystal crew member.
section_notes.QUESTS_ENGI: Two events outside this list can also plant the Hidden Federation Base marker: {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}}, and {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} if you have Engi crew.

steps.title: {{ENGI_UNLOCK_1}}
steps.detail: The guaranteed beacon. The quest only starts through the **Engi crew** blue option — both plain choices end the event where it stands.

steps.title: Two beacons get marked — one real, one decoy
steps.detail: Both quest markers are planted at once. The decoy is a Rebel fight that leads nowhere; the real one continues the chain when you accept its surrender.

steps.title: Mantis ambush
steps.detail: A Mantis ship sitting on the stolen tech. A straight fight, no choices.

steps.title: Hand the tech over
steps.detail: Hull repaired 20, a high standard reward, the **Titanium System Casing** augment, and the ship unlocks — "built near the Engi homeworlds… they only trust their own kind."

items.text: Starts the ship-unlock quest, and adds an out to the virus, the Mantis-attacked station, the smashed ships and the defense satellite.
Level 2 or 3 opens branches across the wreckage, the asteroid belt, the federation signal and both Engi station events.
Long-Ranged Scanners, including the one that makes {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}} safe to work.
Escape routes out of the Mantis fight, the storage station and the defense system.
Three graded payoffs inside {{ENGI_VIRUS}} — the higher the level, the better the deal.
A clean solve on {{ENGI_VIRUS}}, with no fight and no loss.

panels.title: Named things you can leave with

items.text: **Damaged Stasis Pod** — the Crystal route starts at {{ASTEROID_DERELICT_SHIP}}.
**Crystal crew member** at {{ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY}}, if you are already carrying the pod.
**Engi Med-bot Dispersal**, and the **Healing Burst** bomb, both from {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REBEL}}.
**An Engi with two levels in every skill** — the reborn virus, if you let {{ENGI_VIRUS}} run its course.
Engi crew from {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} and {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}}; Mantis from {{ALISON_MANTIS_CREW}} and {{CONFUSED_MANTIS}}.
Five events in the pool can kill a crew member outright, {{DISTRESS_INFESTATION}} and {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}} among them.
{{ENGI_VIRUS}} can halve your shields **and** your engines before the fight even starts.
Six events put someone aboard — up to four at {{FUELING_STATION}}, two to three humans on {{FEDERATION_PLANET_SIGNAL}}.
{{ENGI_FLEET_DELAY}} trades two missiles for two jumps of fleet delay. Cheap if you are not flying missiles.
No nebula line anywhere in the table, so nothing on this map halves the fleet's advance for you — every jump is paid at full price.
